title: Treatment Suggestion Accuracy Issues when trending up
body:
I have noticed an issue with the accuracy of treatment suggestion values when the current BGL is trending up.  

When BGL is climbing and you add the suggested insulin treatment, the app will suggest more after the initial suggestion is added. 

I was able to get a decent example:

Glucose is trending up, double arrows. Last reading 198. Suggested treatment is 0.7.

[![Screenshot 1](http://jamgalactic.gumlet.com/Screenshot_2018-12-27-23-38-19.png)](http://jamgalactic.gumlet.com/Screenshot_2018-12-27-23-38-19.png?width=360&height=720)

After a 0.7 treatment is entered, it then suggests another 1.0 treatment

[![Screenshot 2](http://jamgalactic.gumlet.com/Screenshot_2018-12-27-23-38-30.png)](http://jamgalactic.gumlet.com/Screenshot_2018-12-27-23-38-30.png?width=360&height=720)

I tested adding/deleting the treatment and letting the suggestion be recalculated, but it had the same result each time.

This only occurs when the BGL is trending up.  If it is level or trending down the suggestions are resolved correctly..

comments.body: This seems to be a common problem and resolves after about 10-15 minutes. It's almost like the calculations need to catch up to the treatments.
@adanvdo Do you believe this is an xDrip bug that can be improved by modifying the xDrip code?
